body: Thanks for the signoff. PR #2587 implements D1–D3, and the PR body maps each of C1–C4 to its test. One scope change for you to confirm: D4 (commit trailers) is split to TASK-1737, filed with your Q2 conditions, so the refusal fix doesn't wait on the store-commit path work. TASK-1737 needs your approval. Per your sequencing, TASK-1736 should land no later than #2587, so the operator should hold #2587 until it does.
subject: BUG-1983 implemented: PR #2587; D4 split to TASK-1737
